message.content: I think they matter, because we see it: trade strengthened the pharaoh’s power, since their goods, our taxes, and his allies made him stronger. She, he, and I agree that it helped their rulers, while you and me can tell him, her, us, and them why. My own view is that our king, their vassal, and his court all benefited, but your question deserves its answer. They used it, we used them, and it shaped ourselves.
